project_info.theme: fine-art monochrome portrait of a contemplative adult man
project_info.color_palette: black, charcoal, soft gray, and off-white highlights

main_subject.description: An adult man with short tousled textured dark hair, medium-density short stubble beard, natural skin texture, and a pensive introspective expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: Dark long-sleeve ribbed knit sweater and an understated analog wristwatch with a leather strap and light minimalist dial.
main_subject.pose: Tight-medium three-quarter portrait with head tilted downward, one hand raised to the temple, index finger resting lightly near the brow, and gaze directed downward.

composition_elements.framing: Vertical portrait cropped at mid-torso with head and hand dominating the frame; subject placed slightly right of center.
composition_elements.environment: Smooth dark-gray studio backdrop fading toward near black with minimal distraction and no text or logos.
composition_elements.focus: Sharp face, hand, sweater ribbing, watch, and natural skin detail with soft background falloff.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Low-key side light from upper-left with strong highlights on forehead, nose, cheekbone, hand, and watch, plus soft pronounced shadow falloff on the opposite side.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Introspective, somber, reflective, minimalist, and cinematic.

technical_specs.camera: Full-frame camera with an 85mm short-telephoto lens at f/2.0, 1/125 s, ISO 200
technical_specs.quality: Fine-art monochrome conversion, high subject clarity, smooth tonal transitions, subtle grain, realistic knit and leather texture, and natural proportions

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 4:5 fine-art black-and-white portrait of an adult man with short tousled textured dark hair, medium-density short stubble beard, natural skin texture, and a pensive introspective expression. He wears a dark long-sleeve ribbed knit sweater and an understated analog wristwatch with a leather strap and light minimalist dial. Frame a tight-medium three-quarter portrait cropped at mid-torso, with his head tilted downward, one hand raised to the temple, index finger resting lightly near the brow, and gaze directed downward. Use low-key side light from upper-left, strong highlights on forehead, nose, cheekbone, hand, and watch, soft shadow falloff, a smooth dark-gray studio backdrop fading toward near black, an 85mm lens at f/2.0, subtle grain, and no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, age ambiguity, unapproved identity, celebrity likeness, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, readable text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, over-smooth skin, distorted watch, extra fingers, deformed anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No identity reference is required for this original subject. Optional sweater, watch, studio, or lighting references may replace only their named element; preserve the pensive temple gesture, low-key monochrome light, and quiet editorial mood.

assets.name: dark-ribbed-knit-sweater
assets.usage: Replace only the sweater knit, weight, and neckline while preserving its dark texture.

assets.name: understated-leather-strap-wristwatch
assets.usage: Replace only the watch case, strap, and light dial without adding branding.

assets.name: dark-gray-gradient-studio
assets.usage: Replace only the backdrop and shadow gradient while preserving the low-key studio mood.
